title: The Broken Promise
summary: Ha-Jun remembers his elder brother and the night he failed to save him seven years ago. Overcome by agonizing guilt and helplessness, he breaks down in the torrential rain on the university rooftop—unwittingly pressing the razor-sharp demonic feather into his bleeding palm.

panels.action: 17yo Ha-Jun kneeling in the rain holding the glowing obsidian feather close to his chest, steam rising from his soaked navy blazer.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Kyun... yeh feather itna jaana-pehchana lag raha hai?

panels.prose_en: Seventeen-year-old Ha-Jun knelt in the pouring rain upon the deserted rooftop of Saint Mirren University. He held the radiant obsidian feather close to his chest as white steam hissed from his soaked navy blazer.
panels.prose_hi: Saint Mirren University ki veeraan chhat par satra saal ka Ha-Jun baarish mein ghutno ke bal baitha hua tha. Usne us baingani roshni bikherte obsidian pankh ko apne seene se chipka rakha tha, aur uske bheege hue navy blazer se garam bhaap nikal rahi thi.

panels.action: Extreme close-up on Ha-Jun's dark brown eyes trembling as radiant violet reflections trigger a deep, buried memory.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's dark brown eyes trembled. The pulsing violet reflections danced across his pupils, awakening an agonizing memory long buried in the depths of his past.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki thaki hui aankhein kaanp uthi. Pankh se nikalne wali baingani roshni uski aankhon ki putliyon mein chamak rahi thi, aur uski ajeeb mehak ne uske dimaagh mein saalon purani dafan yaadon ko zinda kar diya.

panels.action: The rain sound distorts into deep sub-bass frequencies as the dark rainy sky warps into a blurry monochrome vignette.
panels.prose_en: The roaring downpour distorted into deep sub-bass frequencies as the dark rainy sky warped into the faded monochrome haze of the past.
panels.prose_hi: Toofani baarish ka shor achanak dheema padne laga aur uski jagah ek gehra, tharrane wala sannata chhaa gaya. Aasmaan ka andhera ghoomte hue ek dhundli monochrome yaadon ke raste mein badal gaya.

panels.action: Flashback 7 years ago: A narrow, decaying industrial alleyway at midnight in torrential rain, rusted fire escapes and flickering yellow streetlights.

dialogue.text: Saat saal pehle... us raat bhi aisi hi baarish thi.

panels.prose_en: Seven years ago, on a midnight drenched in torrential rain, a narrow industrial alleyway lay beneath the flickering amber glow of dying streetlamps.
panels.prose_hi: Saat saal pehle ki ek kaali raat thi... Ek toota-phoota purana industrial ilaqa aur aadhi raat ki toofani baarish. Peeli sadak batti ke neeche paani ka sailab beh raha tha aur har taraf manhoos khamoshi thi.

panels.action: 10-year-old young Ha-Jun cowering behind a rusted metal dumpster, trembling violently in soaked oversized clothes.
panels.prose_en: Ten-year-old Ha-Jun cowered behind a rusted metal dumpster, soaked in oversized clothes and shivering violently with childhood terror.
panels.prose_hi: Us toofani raat mein, dus saal ka chhota Ha-Jun ek zang lage lohe ke dumpster ke peeche chupa hua tha. Apne bheegte hue oversized kapdon mein wo khauf se buri tarah kaanp raha tha.

panels.action: Young elder brother Kang Tae-Jun (16yo, tall, black trench coat, sharp jawline) stepping firmly between little Ha-Jun and the alley entrance.

dialogue.speaker: elder_brother
dialogue.text: Darna mat, Ha-Jun. Main hoon na.

panels.prose_en: Stepping firmly into the rain was his sixteen-year-old brother, Kang Tae-Jun. Cloaked in a black trench coat, he positioned himself between little Ha-Jun and the alley entrance.
panels.prose_hi: Tabhi ek aawaz aayi. Ha-Jun ka solah saal ka bada bhai Kang Tae-Jun, kala trench coat pehne, chhotey Ha-Jun ke theek aage aakar dhaal bankar khada ho gaya.

panels.action: Tae-Jun turning his head back over his shoulder with a gentle, reassuring smile, despite blood dripping from a cut on his brow.

dialogue.speaker: elder_brother
dialogue.text: Apni aankhein band kar lo. Sab theek ho jayega.

panels.prose_en: Despite fresh blood dripping from a cut above his brow, Tae-Jun turned his head back over his shoulder with a gentle, reassuring smile.
panels.prose_hi: Maathe par zakhm se khoon tapakne ke bawajood, Tae-Jun ne apna sar mudaya aur toofani baarish ke beech chhotey Ha-Jun ko dekhkar ek be-inteha pyari aur tasalli bhari muskurahat di.

panels.action: Across the dark flooded alley, multiple shadowy demonic beasts with glowing crimson eyes and razor claws emerge from swirling black mist.
panels.prose_en: Across the dark flooded alley, monstrous demonic beasts with glowing crimson eyes and razor claws crept outward from swirling black mist.
panels.prose_hi: Andheri gali ke doosre kone se ek khaufnaak shaitani manzar ubhar aaya. Kaale ghoomte hue dhuen ke beech se laal dehkti aankhon aur teekhe panjon wale kai demonic beasts bahar nikal aaye.

panels.action: A monstrous demonic beast lunges forward with jagged claws tearing through the brick walls of the alley.
panels.prose_en: A monstrous demonic beast lunged forward with explosive ferocity, its jagged claws ripping through the brick walls of the alley!
panels.prose_hi: KRRSH! Ek vishaal shaitani darinde ne aage chhalang lagayi, aur uske teekhe panjon ne gali ki eenton ki deewaron ko mitti ki tarah cheer diya!

panels.action: Tae-Jun raising his bare hand, manifesting a glowing dark-blue and violet demonic energy barrier that deflects the beast's attack.
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun raised his bare hand, conjuring a brilliant dark-blue and violet demonic energy barrier that deflected the beast's lethal claws with an electrifying crack!
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun ne apna nanga haath aage badhaya. Palak jhapakte hi neeli aur baingani roshni ki ek chamakti hui magical barrier prakat ho gayi, jisne us shaitani hamle ko zordaar aawaz ke sath rok diya!

panels.action: Tae-Jun gritting his teeth in strain as fine cracks spiderweb across the magical barrier under crushing demonic force.
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun gritted his teeth in agony. Under the crushing demonic pressure, fine cracks began spiderwebbing across the magical barrier.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun ne dard se daant bheenchte hue poori taqat laga di. Darinde ke bayaan-naak dabaav se us magical barrier par kanch ki tarah daraarein padne lagi thi.

panels.action: Little Ha-Jun peeking through his trembling, rain-soaked fingers behind the dumpster, pupils shrunk in sheer terror.

dialogue.speaker: young_hajun
dialogue.text: M-Mujhe kuch karna hoga... lekin mere pair hil nahi rahe...!

panels.prose_en: Behind the dumpster, little Ha-Jun peeked through his trembling, rain-soaked fingers, his pupils shrunk in paralyzing terror as his legs refused to move.
panels.prose_hi: Dumpster ke peeche se chhota Ha-Jun apni kaanpti hui ungliyon ke beech se ye khaufnaak manzar dekh raha tha. Uski aankhein dehshat se pathra gayi thi aur pair jam chuke the.

panels.action: Tae-Jun shouting back with fierce desperation, hair whipped by rain and mana shockwaves.

dialogue.speaker: elder_brother
dialogue.text: BHAAGO, HA-JUN! PEECHE MAT DEKHNA! MUJHSE VAADA KARO KI TUM JIYOGE!

panels.prose_en: His hair whipped by rain and shockwaves, Tae-Jun shouted back with desperate fury: 'RUN, HA-JUN! DON'T LOOK BACK! PROMISE ME YOU WILL LIVE!'
panels.prose_hi: Toofani hawa aur mana shockwaves ke beech Tae-Jun ne cheekh kar aakhri aadesh diya: 'BHAAGO, HA-JUN! PEECHE MAT DEKHNA! MUJHSE VAADA KARO KI TUM JIYOGE!'

panels.action: A jagged black demonic spear pierces through Tae-Jun's shoulder from behind in a high-contrast black-and-crimson silhouette.
panels.prose_en: A jagged black demonic spear pierced straight through Tae-Jun's shoulder from behind in a brutal, high-contrast silhouette of black and crimson!
panels.prose_hi: SHLK! Achanak andhere se nikle ek kaale shaitani bhaale ne Tae-Jun ke kandhe ko peeche se bedardi se cheer diya! Ek laal aur kaale saaye mein khoon ka favaara nikal pada.

panels.action: Tae-Jun's bloodied hand slipping away from little Ha-Jun's outstretched reaching fingers into a swirling void rift.
panels.prose_en: A swirling dimensional void opened in the air. Tae-Jun's bloodied hand slipped away from little Ha-Jun's reaching fingertips, dragged mercilessly into the rift.
panels.prose_hi: Gali mein ek ajeeb dimensional void rift khul gayi. Tae-Jun ka khoon se lathpath haath chhotey Ha-Jun ki taraf phaila, lekin ungliyan chhoot kar us ghoomti hui shaitani daraar mein khinchne lagi.

panels.action: The black rift collapses violently into a pinprick of light, sucking the demonic beasts and Tae-Jun away into complete silence.
panels.prose_en: The black rift collapsed violently into a pinprick of light, sucking the demonic beasts and Tae-Jun away into absolute, deafening silence.
panels.prose_hi: VOOOSH! Wo kaali daraar roshni ki ek nanhi chingaari mein simat kar hamesha ke liye band ho gayi. Saare shaitan aur bada bhai Tae-Jun us andhere mein gayab ho gaye... chhod gaye toh sirf ek sanate bhari baarish.

panels.action: Harsh snap back to present day: Extreme close-up of 17yo Ha-Jun's eye dilating in visceral panic on the cold wet rooftop floor.
panels.prose_en: Kneeling in the flooded alleyway, little Ha-Jun screamed his soul into the storm, tears streaming down his face as the thunder swallowed his cries.
panels.prose_hi: Gali ke keechad aur paani mein gira chhota Ha-Jun apne dono haathon se sar pakad kar aasmaan ki taraf cheekh pada. Uski cheekhon mein dil cheer dene wala dard tha.

panels.action: Ha-Jun collapsing forward onto both hands and knees into a rain puddle, water splashing heavily over his battered uniform.
panels.prose_en: Digging his small fingers into the rain-soaked mud, he glared at the stormy heavens through tears of pure sorrow, swearing an oath he would never forget.
panels.prose_hi: Uski nanhi ungliyan zameen ke keechad mein dhas gayi. Rote hue usne toofani aasmaan ki taraf dekha aur kasam khayi ki wo apne bhai ka badla zaroor lega.

panels.action: Vast panoramic overhead view of the lonely, drenched teenager on the sprawling concrete university rooftop surrounded by towering skyscrapers.

dialogue.text: Us raat ke baad se... duniya ke liye wo gayab ho gaya.

panels.prose_en: Reality snapped back into focus. Seventeen-year-old Ha-Jun was back on the cold rooftop of Saint Mirren University, the glowing obsidian feather still burning in his trembling grasp.
panels.prose_hi: Aur phir ek jhatke mein yaad khatam ho gayi. Haqeeqat mein laut-te hi, satra saal ka Ha-Jun Saint Mirren University ki chhat par ghutno ke bal baitha hua tha, haath mein wahi shaitani baingani pankh tha.

panels.action: Ha-Jun clutching his drenched black hair with his left hand, his right hand still desperately grasping Kuro's glowing feather.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Lekin sach toh yeh hai... maine unhe chhod diya tha.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun clutched his chest in raw agony as the memory ripped open old wounds, drowning his soul in unbearable guilt.
panels.prose_hi: Uski chhati dard se phatne lagi thi. Saalon se dafan dukh aur gunaah ka ehsaas uske dil par khanjar ki tarah chala gaya.

panels.action: Ha-Jun's face tilted downward, hot tears streaming down his bruised cheeks, mouth wide in an agonizing, silent sob amidst heavy rainfall.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: MAIN BHAAG GAYA THA! MAIN ITNA KAMZOR THA...!

panels.prose_en: His voice cracked into choked, agonizing whispers: 'I was too weak... I couldn't save him...!'
panels.prose_hi: Aankhon se lagataar behte aansuon ke beech Ha-Jun ki aawaz toot gayi: 'Main kamzor tha... main bhaiya ko bacha nahi paaya...!'

panels.action: Ha-Jun slamming his left scraped fist hard into the wet concrete, sending rainwater spraying and hairline cracks radiating outward.
panels.prose_en: In overwhelming grief and furious self-hatred, Ha-Jun clenched his fist tightly over the obsidian feather, his body shivering with helpless rage.
panels.prose_hi: Bebasi aur apni kamzori par aate gusse mein, Ha-Jun ne apni mutthi ko us kaale pankh ke upar poori taqat se bheencha.

panels.action: In his right palm, Kuro's feather begins vibrating and pulsing with an intense, rhythmic crimson-violet heartbeat glow.
panels.prose_en: The razor-sharp obsidian quill pierced deep into the flesh of his palm, breaking the skin with a sudden sharp sting.
panels.prose_hi: Pankh ki nok itni teekhi thi ki usne Ha-Jun ki hatheli ki khaal ko cheer diya. Ek taaza, gehra zakhm ban gaya.

panels.action: Ha-Jun clenching his right fist with furious intensity around the feather, heedless of the sharp obsidian quill pressing deep into his flesh.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Agar mere paas taqat hoti... toh kya bhaiya aaj yahan hote?

panels.prose_en: Fresh crimson blood welled from his cut palm, coating the iridescent violet barbs of the feather in warm droplets.
panels.prose_hi: Uski hatheli se laal khoon ris kar us baingani chamakne wale pankh ke reshon par lag gaya.

panels.action: The razor-sharp obsidian tip of the feather's quill punctures Ha-Jun's pale palm. A thick, vibrant droplet of scarlet blood wells up.
panels.prose_en: The feather reacted violently, drinking every drop of Ha-Jun's blood as its violet light ignited into furious, incandescent blood-crimson magma!
panels.prose_hi: Pankh ne jaise hi Ha-Jun ke khoon ka swaad chakha, wo achanak daldalate hue laal aur baingani magma ki tarah dahakne laga! Khoon hawa mein gayab ho gaya aur pankh ne use pee liya!

panels.action: The scarlet droplet touches the glowing violet barb of Kuro's feather. Time seems to slow to a standstill.

dialogue.text: Ek lahu ka qatra... aur sadiyon purana bandhan toot gaya.

panels.prose_en: Micro-threads of crimson and violet mana uncoiled from the burning quill, burrowing directly under Ha-Jun's epidermis and fusing with his veins!
panels.prose_hi: Pankh se baingani aur laal mana ke baareek dhaage nikle aur Ha-Jun ki hatheli ke zakhm ke zariye uski chamdi aur ragon ke andar dhasne lage!

panels.action: The scarlet blood does not wash away in the rain; it is drawn into the feather's veins, illuminating the black plumage with glowing red and violet circuits.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun gasped in agonizing, blinding shock as the feather dissolved completely, merging directly into the bone and marrow of his right arm!
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun dard se cheekh pada! Wo shaitani pankh dheere-dheere pighal kar uski hatheli, haddiyon aur ragon ke sath hamesha ke liye judne laga!

panels.action: Ha-Jun gasps, freezing in shock as burning supernatural heat surges directly from the feather into his wrist and forearm veins.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Y-Yeh kya hai...?! Mere haath ke andar...!

panels.prose_en: A catastrophic shockwave of violet mana detonated outward from his fist, blasting the downpour away in an empty twenty-meter circle of crackling power!
panels.prose_hi: BOOOM! Uske dahine haath se baingani mana ka ek zordar toofani dhamaka hua! Bees meter ke daayre mein saari toofani baarish ki boondein door phek di gayi!

panels.action: Ha-Jun staring wide-eyed at his right arm as black and violet demonic veins crawl beneath his skin, emitting white cleansing steam.
panels.prose_en: Dark purple demonic scales and razor-sharp crystalline armor plates rapidly materialized over Ha-Jun's right hand and forearm, locking into place.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ke dahine haath aur baazu par baingani shaitani scales aur chamakte hue crystalline armor ke plates tezi se ubharne lage.

panels.action: Grand climactic shot: Storm clouds swirl into a gigantic vortex directly above Ha-Jun. Violet lightning forks across the sky as a ghostly demonic eye opens within the clouds.

dialogue.text: AKHIR KAAR... SOVEREIGN KA KHOON JAAG UTHTA HAI.

panels.prose_en: The legendary Sovereign's Gauntlet locked onto his arm. Before his glowing crimson-violet eyes, a celestial holographic interface flashed to life: [RELIC 1: THE OBSIDIAN PLUME ASSIMILATED — BOND 100%].
panels.prose_hi: Sovereign's Gauntlet uske baazu par bandh gaya. Uski aankhon ke theek saamne ek chamakti hui khooni holographic screen khul gayi: [RELIC 1: THE OBSIDIAN PLUME ASSIMILATED — BOND 100%].
